item.title: Beyond the Dashboard
item.description:
Introduction

Many people associate data analytics with dashboards, reports, and charts. Yet the dashboard is often the smallest part of the analyst’s work.

Behind every metric, trend line, and KPI (Key Performance Indicator) lies a series of questions, investigations, validations, and business decisions. Before a chart reaches an executive meeting, an analyst has already spent hours understanding the problem, examining the data, and determining whether the results can be trusted.
